title: The Allure — Mere Minutes from Downtown & More
description:
Make yourself at home in this lovely and open, townhome-styled condo! It's all-too-easy to settle in for the night within the privacy of this complex, but easy to find your way to all that Nashville has to offer! A mere 10 minute drive to Broadway, with similar & shorter travels to other wonderful must-see's around town. The interior itself offers modern arrangements with a spacious, open layout with enough natural light to never need to hit a switch during the day. We can't wait to welcome you!

The space
Upon entry, you'll make your way up a flight of stairs to the open living area connected to a full kitchen and dining area all of which are spacious and comfortable. Around the corner you'll find your secondary bedroom, as well as a full bath. Further down the hall are the stairs that lead up to your primary bedroom and overlook patio!

The downstairs bedroom has one double bed. 
The upstair bedroom is spacious and has two double beds and a very large closet. 
There is a double bed pull out sofa in the first floor living room.

Guest access
Everything you see is yours to use! The only part we ask to keep private is the storage bin.
